column56: The current parking arrangement is very stressful and inconvenient, especially for employees who commute from other cities or live far from the office. Because of the distance and heavy traffic, we often need to leave promptly at the end of our shifts to avoid making an already long commute even more stressful.  Cars are parked two-deep, so employees are frequently blocked by another vehicle and must request through a group chat that the car in front be moved. Responses are not always immediate, which can cause significant delays. Additionally, there is little to no phone signal in the parking area, so we may have to return to the fifth floor just to send the message.  A more accessible parking arrangement or a reliable process that prevents vehicles from being blocked would greatly reduce stress and unnecessary delays, particularly for employees with long commutes.
